lines.requirement: Every new loan application, from brokers or our own channels, lands in one queue with an owner within minutes of arriving.
lines.why: Applications wait a day or two for allocation before anyone looks at them, which slows time to decision.

lines.requirement: Each application shows its stage, who owns it and how long it has waited at that stage.
lines.why: Leaders can't see where files are stuck until brokers complain.

lines.product: Business Studio (no-code objects, pages, processes)

lines.requirement: Lending managers see time to decision by stage and by channel every morning.

lines.requirement: Each application builds its own checklist of required documents from rules the lending team keeps for each product.

lines.requirement: Requests for missing documents go to the broker or customer from the application, and every request stays on the file.

lines.kpi: First-contact resolution: average ~69% (range 43–88%); 70–79% good; 80%+ world-class (~5% of centres); complaints ~48% (source: CORE pack v0.2 §4, SQM Group 2024, Strong)
lines.how_we_show: configure: chart of root causes on repeat cases (P05)
lines.product: Business Studio (Freedom UI home page: indicators, charts, lists)
lines.source: CORE pack v0.2 §3 J3 step 6

lines.requirement: The service team adds a new case type with its own fields, steps and targets the same day, without IT.
lines.why: Every process change waits in the IT backlog.
lines.how_we_show: configure: live change of a case type and its rule row (M6 T1/T2)
lines.product: Business Studio (rules object read by a process, P04)
lines.source: CORE pack v0.2 §2 C-H10; §1 CP8

lines.requirement: Knowledge articles are reviewed on a schedule and flagged when they are out of date.
lines.why: Outdated articles give customers and agents the wrong answer.
lines.how_we_show: configure: review date on articles and a reminder process
lines.product: Service Creatio (knowledge base)
lines.source: CORE pack v0.2 §3 J3 step 4
